about_the_game:
Enter the mysterious world of Ether@Net, a first-person horror puzzle adventure set against the backdrop of urban Hong Kong. You play as Alex, a skilled mystery solver from a secret organization, tasked with investigating a series of unusual occurrences in a haunted apartment building. As you uncover the hidden secrets, you’ll find yourself caught between the digital world and the supernatural realm, solving mysteries that connect the living with the dead.

Game Features:

  • Supernatural Mystery: Explore eerie apartments and interact with ghostly presences to uncover the truth behind a digital and spiritual enigma. Every puzzle you solve brings you closer to revealing the dark secrets of the city’s most forgotten spirits and unresolved cases.

  • Challenging Puzzles: Use your investigative skills to uncover hidden clues and solve complex puzzles, blending modern technology with supernatural elements. Each step forward leads you deeper into the haunted apartment’s twisted past.

  • Immersive Environments: Discover intricately designed locations, from dilapidated tenements to high-tech modern apartments, each filled with rich history and atmosphere that enhance the chilling narrative.

  • Engaging Storyline: Join forces with spiritual guides and tormented souls as you delve into the mystery of a haunted case. The story merges contemporary technology with urban legends, offering a thrilling, horror-filled journey with a unique twist.

  • Atmospheric Sound Design: Immerse yourself in eerie soundscapes, from creaking floorboards to the whispers of the dead. The carefully crafted audio will heighten the horror experience, drawing you deeper into the chilling events.

  • Multiple Endings: Your choices and actions will influence the outcome of the game. Depending on your decisions, the game can lead to different endings, reflecting the choices you make during your investigation.

Prepare for an unforgettable journey

In Ether@Net, every corner, every puzzle, brings you closer to uncovering the sinister forces at play. Can you unravel the mystery, uncover the truth, and help lost souls find peace? Or will you be consumed by the evil lurking in the shadows? You control the fate of both the living and the dead as you decide the future of the city.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon R9 280X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

short_description: Unravel the supernatural mysteries in Ether@Net! As a mystery solver from a secret organization, explore Hong Kong's haunted apartments, face otherworldly forces, and team up with a spiritual guide and haunted souls. An exciting blend of mystery and adventure awaits in this thrilling game!
